items.text: An HR fresher is hired for clear communication, accurate records, recruitment basics, awareness of labour rules, spreadsheet skill and fairness, and the best proof is a candidate tracker and a mock interview record that someone else can check.
Learn six skills in this order: communication, records, recruitment steps, Excel, labour rule awareness and confidentiality.
Check the current provisions on the labour ministry and state pages before you quote any rule.
